column1: # memfn/data/policy.tsv — THE KIT POLICY TABLE (R-35 (e); [KIT-POLICY-TABLE]; span_cards.md §6 "Where it
# lives", review 2026-11-06 r9 SLOT-17). POLICY constants, not measured costs of a box: they live in this ONE
# table outside the sets, so a re-measure never moves a policy (D166). Each row is labelled POLICY with its
# reason (memory pcrec-suspect-tuning-constants). z and MATERIAL join WITH their reader, row 1 (D77); the gate
# default is here first because the stage-2 slot reads it now.
# Columns: name value reason. One row per name.
#   gate_default_e6   the gate_e6 of a card that states `-` (kit-grid@3's four cards). Readers: (1)
#                     docs/design/memfn/span_cards/slot/plan.py at the dry run, which freezes this row into the
#                     run's plan; the run record pins it (`policy` section, this file's sha-256) and the slot's
#                     est.py reads only that pinned copy; (2) the cards a set carries keep `-` (check C,
#                     tests/memfn/finder_check.py, requires a set's cards equal to its card table), so a
#                     set's recompute takes the value from the run record (span_cards.md §2.4, r9fc FIX-8)
#   r_max_e6          the cap on a delta row's resolution r (docs/spec/measures.md §3.5¶3a; review 2026-11-06 r10
#                     REV14-2): a sub-resolution row's r is min(its own r, this). Derived by
#                     docs/design/memfn/span_cards/rmax_drill.py from the first window's A/A rows. Readers: the
#                     slot's est.py, from the run record's pinned copy (a record planned before this row: the live
#                     row, named in est's output)
#name
gate_default_e6
